scripts.build: pnpm --filter @incidentlens/config --filter @incidentlens/contracts --filter @incidentlens/runtime run build && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/web --filter @incidentlens/api --filter @incidentlens/worker run build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.dev: pnpm runtime:up && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/config build && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/runtime build && pnpm --parallel --filter @incidentlens/web --filter @incidentlens/api --filter @incidentlens/worker run dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @incidentlens/config build && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/runtime build && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/api dev
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm --filter @incidentlens/config build && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/runtime build && pnpm --filter @incidentlens/worker dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @incidentlens/config --filter @incidentlens/runtime run build && pnpm --recursive --if-present run typecheck
